title: Grunbaum's Conjecture
exact_target: The historical conjecture concerns three-edge-colourability of duals of simple orientable triangulations. The source also asks weaker versions with large face-width, either uniformly or depending on the surface, and discusses snark embeddings.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 3314 (OPG-177). CC BY 4.0.
